dashboard.label: Cloud Detection Lab
dashboard.description: CloudTrail event counts, login detections, and outcomes from manually uploaded samples. Real and synthetic events are labeled separately. Panels include all available sample events.

search.query: index=cloud_detection_lab sourcetype=cloud_detection_json_utc | search project="cloud_detection" | eval event_key=coalesce(account_id,"unknown").":".event_id | dedup dataset_id sample_kind event_key | fields sample_kind event_source event_name outcome mfa_used event_id event_time principal source_ip
search sample_kind="live" | stats count AS events
search sample_kind="synthetic" | stats count AS events

search sample_kind="synthetic" event_source="signin.amazonaws.com" event_name="ConsoleLogin" outcome="success" | eval mfa_text=lower(tostring(mfa_used)) | where mfa_text="false" | stats count AS findings
search sample_kind="live" event_source="signin.amazonaws.com" event_name="ConsoleLogin" outcome="success" | eval mfa_text=lower(tostring(mfa_used)) | where mfa_text="false" | stats count AS findings
stats count AS events BY sample_kind outcome
